items.headline: Connelly on Week 10: His 14 favorite games on loaded schedule
items.description: The Week 10 schedule is the most anticipated of the season. Here are the keys to all the major matchups.

items.headline: Middle Tennessee and Western Kentucky meet in CUSA action
items.description: Western Kentucky (3-5) at Middle Tennessee (4-4), Nov. 7 at 3:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Nick Minicucci throws for 414 yards and 4 TDs as Delaware beats Western Kentucky 35-21
items.description: — Nick Minicucci threw for 414 yards and four touchdowns, with 183 yards and two scores going to Sean Wilson, and Delaware beat Western Kentucky 35-21 on Tuesday night to snap a seven-game road losing streak.

items.headline: Delaware and Western Kentucky meet in CUSA action
items.description: Delaware (3-4) at Western Kentucky (3-4), Oct. 27 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Campbell hits 3 FGs as Western Kentucky defeats Sam Houston 16-3
items.description: — Brock Glenn and Coleson Arends connected on the game's lone touchdown, Karl Campbell hit all three of his field goal attempts, and Western Kentucky took down Sam Houston 16-3 on Wednesday night.
